description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the sample count across four different text genres for two distinct groups. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, without an explicit axis label or specific sorting order. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Sample Count," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to slightly above 130, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20. The chart features grouped bars, where each category contains two adjacent bars representing the groups defined in the top-center legend: "Open" depicted in light blue on the left, and "Cons." depicted in light pink on the right. Every bar is annotated with its exact numeric value in bold text directly above it. Within the light blue "Open" group, values range from a minimum of 62 for Expository to a maximum of 80 for Narrative, with Argumentative at 79 and Descriptive at 68. Within the light pink "Cons." group, values range from a minimum of 87 for Narrative to a maximum of 130 for Expository, with Argumentative at 122 and Descriptive at 100. Notably, a small, solid grey rectangle is visually emphasized, floating just above the 100-value "Cons." bar in the Descriptive category.
